jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Node.js
jobs_results.description:
Check-in Scan, líder en soluciones tecnológicas para la gestión eficiente de check-ins y registros, está en búsqueda de un(a):

Desarrollador/a Node.js altamente motivado(a) y apasionado(a) por la innovación para unirse a nuestro equipo en La Cala de Mijas.

Responsabilidades:

Desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones backend en Node.js.

Colaborar con el equipo de frontend y diseño para crear soluciones integradas y eficientes.

Contribuir en todas las fases del desarrollo, desde la concepción hasta el lanzamiento y el soporte post-lanzamiento.

Asegurar la calidad del código, incluyendo pruebas unitarias y de integración.

Participar activamente en el proceso de revisión de código y en la mejora continua de nuestros procesos de desarrollo.

Requisitos:

Experiencia demostrable en desarrollo de aplicaciones con Node.js.

Buen conocimiento de bases de datos (SQL y NoSQL).

Familiaridad con el control de versiones, preferiblemente Git.

Capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente... y en equipo.

Nos encantaría si también tienes:

Experiencia con frameworks frontend (React, Vue.js, Angular).

Conocimientos en contenedores y orquestación (Docker, Kubernetes).

Experiencia en metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban).

Ofrecemos:
• Jornada completa
• Puesto presencial en La Cala de Mijas (Málaga) de lunes a jueves
• Viernes teletrabajo
• Horario: 8:00 a 15:30h

jobs_results.title: Senior Fullstack (Nodejs) remote possible
jobs_results.description:
About de company

We're on a mission to transform sales performance through our cutting-edge AI sales coach. Our platform empowers sales representatives by helping them prioritize, automate, and personalize their sales pipeline actions, leveraging advanced AI and machine learning technologies. We're looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer to join our backend team, someone passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI technologies and dedicated to building robust, scalable, and innovative backend systems.

Responsibilities
• Lead the design and implementation of backend services to AI sales coach, ensuring high performance, scalability, and reliability.
• Develop and maintain APIs for internal use and external integrations, facilitating seamless connectivity between our platform, LLMs, and various third-party services.
• Collaborate with the frontend team to ensure smooth integration of the React-based UI with backend logic.
• Implement secure, efficient, and maintainable code... following best practices in software development and data security.
• Participate in the entire application lifecycle, focusing on coding, debugging, and system tuning.
• Contribute to the development of AI-driven features, working closely with our AI experts to integrate cutting-edge algorithms and models into our product.
• Ensure code quality and maintainability by conducting code reviews, writing tests, and documenting work.
• Stay up-to-date with emerging trends and technologies in AI, software development, and the sales tech ecosystem, continuously innovating and improving our platform.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on backend technologies.
• Expertise in JavaScript, particularly Node.js and familiarity with React.
• Proven experience with RESTful APIs and external integrations.
• Solid understanding of AI and machine learning concepts, especially as applied to sales and CRM technologies.
• Experience with cloud services (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) and database management.
• Knowledge of software engineering best practices (e.g., testing, code reviews, code reviews, continuous integration) and agile methodologies.
• Excellent problem-solving skills, creativity, and a passion for technology.
• Strong communication and teamwork abilities, capable of working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Why Join Us?
• Founding Team Member: As a Senior Software Engineer at AAA, you won't just be joining an existing team—you'll be a foundational member of our engineering department. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of our technology, influence our company culture, and leave a lasting impact on our product and the sales industry at large.
• Competitive Compensation: We understand the value of top talent and are prepared to offer an attractive salary that matches your experience and skills. We believe in rewarding our team members for their contributions to our success.
• Equity Participation: We're not just offering a job; we're offering a stake in our future. Equity is a part of our compensation package, aligning your success with the company's growth and achievements.
• Work in an environment that values innovation, collaboration, and personal growth.
• Enjoy flexible working arrangements, alongside a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.

We are waiting for you

jobs_results.title: Node.js Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Orange Quarter is working with a market leader in the Digital Agency space that is currently looking for a NodeJS backend developer.

This company essentially helps other businesses (big and small) providing technical solutions to suit their needs.

They have been around for 15 years and are now looking to expand their market into Spain. With an impressive office in Poble Nou, they have a team of 9 and continue to look to build their presence in the Spanish market.

Industry

OQ-industries Agency

Creative agency

OQ-industries Internet

What To Expect

As a Node.js Developer, you will support one of their biggest clients – a global player in the insurance sector – in the digital transformation of its customer management, by building and optimising digital processes and thus helping to save time, costs and paper. You will join another typescript developer and will work closely together.

This project is Germany based, and you will join one of the teams in Munich teams. However, the... Barcelona office is based in Poble Nou and you will be able to either choose to work fully remotely or go to the office on a hybrid model.

Perks
• 40 days work from anywhere / 130 days work form anywhere (depending on work package that you chose, remote or hybrid)
• Flat hierarchies, short decision-making processes and mutual trust
• Work Bike

Requirements

Requirements:
• As a TypeScript / Node.js developer, you have extensive experience in the development and maintenance of web applications.
• You dominate the following tech stack: TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, Angular and have experience with Docker and CI/CD.
• Experience with Go based microservices or PHP is a plus.

Sounds good? Apply now

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador de Node JS
jobs_results.description:
"Great things in business are never done by one person. They're done by a team of people." (Steve Jobs).

It is an incredible time to join our team and become one of the first ‘xplorers’ that help us grow and expand Xplore Group in Spain. Xplore Group is the most successful independent JAVA and PHP solution provider in the Benelux, present in Belgium, the Netherlands, and Spain. We have offices in cities such as Hasselt, Antwerp, Eindhoven, Amsterdam and Valencia.

Our team of highly skilled ‘xplorers’ has a unique approach, combining the experience of world-leading platforms with best practices and the latest technologies, delivering the best experience to our customers.

Xplore Group consists of 45 competence centres, each with their own unique focus on one of the lead technologies, like AWS, Salesforce, Hybris, RPA, Kubernetes, .Net, Azure DevOps. We have gone from 400 to 1200 employees in the last three years.

We have a clear view of the direction we want to take. We work in... multidisciplinary teams, where good practices and high standards are of the highest importance. We use testing, continuous integration and delivery to reduce the time to market for our clients.

Do you want to work in an international company with a startup mentality, where you can speak openly, contribute with creative ideas, learn from experienced colleagues, help us grow and become a key member of the company?

What you will be doing

You will work in one of our international projects and be part of one of our squads with team members from Spain, Belgium, and the Netherlands. You will communicate in English and memes, and use agile methodologies like Scrum and Kanban.

You will put together good practices and collaborate with team members and the client to define, design and develop new functionalities.

You will apply SOLID principles and create unit tests for your functionality, validating it with the CI in Azure DevOpsand measuring it with Sonar.

The first week

jobs_results.description:
Terminalfour is a digital engagement and web content management platform for higher education. We help universities and colleges drive student recruitment, retention, alumni fundraising, and research promotion by maximising the effectiveness of their digital and content strategies.

We´re the No. 1 provider to the higher education sector in the UK and Ireland and we´re quickly becoming the No. 1 provider in North America

We will send you a laptop, monitors, desk etc, whatever you need to get set up remotely, or you can avail of our Bring Your Own Device Policy and work from your own preferred equipment.

Everyone at Terminalfour is currently working remotely, and any return to offices will be voluntary and offer hybrid working options.

We believe in continuous learning, so if you want to enhance your AWS skills, the company will cover the cost of your training and AWS Certification. We also provide paid access to a technical training platform for upskilling and continuous learning... at your own pace.

We are focused on our employee wellbeing, and provide an Employee Assistance Programme to all staff, in all locations. This service provides support for a range of issues, as well as short term counselling, and is available to both employees and their families. In addition, we have a Wellbeing platform which is all about promoting health, wellbeing and generally taking care of ourselves.

Terminalfour offers flexible hours, remote working and 30 days annual leave.

The Role

In this role you would be part of Terminalfour’s BetterExaminations development team working on our online exam management and e-assessment platform. Our platform was built from scratch within the last two years. It is a great opportunity to work with and build on state-of-the-art technologies rather than legacy systems.

Working as part of the development team your role will be creating value for our customers in the form of new features, customer experience enhancements and project integrations. You will need to be proactive in understanding client needs and advocating for their success.

Working closely with our Product Owner you will collaborate to solve problems, creating top class experiences for those taking & administering exams through our platform. As we have a worldwide client base this role will include being available for on-call support when required.

What you will do

•Work as a member of an Agile team to deliver high quality features & enhancements for our multi-tenanted Serverless application.
•Identify and build product enhancements that improve both customer and support experience.
•Make good technical decisions that provide solutions to Product Owner requirements.
•Develop in-product integration points for SSO and other third party systems.
•Work with project teams supporting new client integrations.
•Collaborate with the team to implement continuous improvement learnings as part of the development lifecycle.

Skills and Experience you will need

•Strong development experience in Node.JS, React and GraphQL.
•AWS experience in Cloudformation, Codebuild, Dynamo DB and AWS serverless technologies such as AWS lambda.
•Exposure to provisioning, optimization and performance improvements an advantage.
•A shift-left mindset when it comes to quality, and experience in writing automated tests ideally using Cypress.io.
•Excellent oral and written communication skills.
•Passionate about customers and new technology.
•Ability to work independently, taking the initiative, as well as working in a team environment.
•Fluent English language skills, written and spoken.

We look forward to hearing from you
